headline: The Internet’s Steve Lacy, Syd and Matt Martians Discuss New Music
context: The band members Steve Lacy and Syd, both of whom have new solo albums out now, reunite with the producer Matt Martians to discuss achieving TikTok fame, writing a Beyoncé song and staying a family.

sources.name: The New York Times
